jobs.excerpt: About PhaidraPhaidra is building the future of industrial automation.
jobs.description:
About Phaidra

Phaidra is building the future of industrial automation.

The world today is filled with static, monolithic infrastructure. Factories, power plants, buildings, etc. operate the same they've operated for decades — because the controls programming is hard-coded. Thousands of lines of rules and heuristics that define how the machines interact with each other. The result of all this hard-coding is that facilities are frozen in time, unable to adapt to their environment while their performance slowly degrades.

Phaidra creates AI-powered control systems for the industrial sector, enabling industrial facilities to automatically learn and improve over time. Specifically:

  • We use reinforcement learning algorithms to provide this intelligence, converting raw sensor data into high-value actions and decisions.
  • We focus on industrial applications, which tend to be well-sensorized with measurable KPIs — perfect for reinforcement learning.
  • We enable domain experts (our users) to configure the AI control systems (i.e. agents) without writing code. They define what they want their AI agents to do, and we do it for them.

Our team has a track record of applying AI to some of the toughest problems. From achieving superhuman performance with DeepMind's AlphaGo, to reducing the energy required to cool Google's Data Centers by 40%, we deeply understand AI and how to apply it in production for massive impact.

Phaidra’s ability to achieve its mission is determined by our ability to work together — as defined by our core values: Agency,Velocity, Craft, and Truth. We seek individuals who embody these values, as they are instrumental in ensuring our team consistently delivers excellence and fosters an engaging and supportive culture

Phaidra is based in the USA, but we are 100% remote with no physical office. We hire employees internationally with the help of our partner, OysterHR. Our team is currently located throughout the USA, Canada, UK, Sweden, Spain, Portugal, the Netherlands, Singapore, Australia, and India.

Who You Are

As an AI Controls Solutions Engineer, you'll play a critical role in operationalizing and scaling Phaidra's solutions for enterprise data center customers.

We are seeking a team member located in the following area: USA or Canada.

Responsibilities

You will work closely with the Technical Program Managers (TPMs) and Data Scientists (DSs), as the technical experts for Phaidra's customers. Your role is to use Phaidra's platform and tools to put AI into production.

This role can be broken down into two concrete areas of responsibility:

  • As the subject matter expert, (SME), you will use Phaidra’s products and your knowledge of the customers' needs to create a model of the facility for ingestion by our product lineup. This will require working closely with our Data Science team. You’ll create a representation of the facility in Mort system builder, map tag data, review our Insights logic for facility specific requirements, and assist in analyzing and triaging these systems in the support phase.
  • You will work with the product team to identify and define product requirements based upon each customer’s specification and needs. You will work closely with other AI Controls Solutions Engineers and the Product team to ensure our automated tools enable Phaidra to scale across thousands of customers.

*This role can include 25% travel

Key Qualifications

  • 10-15 years of work experience as a controls engineer, programmer, or equivalent
  • Possesses expertise in HVAC and Data Center cooling control methodologies and strategies and displays knowledge of chiller plant fundamentals, configurations, and sequence of operations
  • Ability to operate as an Solutions Engineer independently.
  • Understanding of applied thermodynamics for cooling systems, refrigeration systems, and hydronics.
  • Experience designing, programming, or strong working knowledge of industrial and commercial control systems and protocols such as BACnet and Modbus.
  • Understanding the applications and control strategies of air side chilled water and direct expansion cooling systems.
  • Ability to troubleshoot, triage, and analyze issues with control systems and equipment.
  • Strong proficiency in working with data center operations teams and contributing to solving field operations related problems and challenges.
  • Experience programming control systems with PLC, ladder logic, text, or block programming languages.
  • Ability to analyze the performance and viability of your engineered solutions.
  • Passion for problem solving and using scalable solutions to solve repeat problems.
  • Ability to translate a combination of customer-stated and customer-implied needs into coherent needs documentation for use by the software development team.
  • Good educational background in one or more related disciplines pertinent to your area of expertise. Example disciplines include Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Control Theory, Applied Mathematics and other various engineering and applied science fields.
  • Ability to read and write Python scripts (in collaboration with the software engineering team) to implement Insights and scrappy tooling.
  • Ability to work independently to resolve onboarding or support tickets by coordinating with the right people or providing direct solutions. You will possesses deep knowledge of Phaidra’s pipelines and effectively identify and addresses issues and manage risks actively.
  • Exhibits excellent communication skills and has the ability to explain complex domain specific concepts to non-domain experts and also explain complex AI and ML specific concepts to non-AI/ML specific customers.
  • Ability to own and manage large sections of documentation, fostering a culture of high standards in documentation and communication.
  • Ability to understand customers well and drive a culture of pragmatic urgency and customer satisfaction.
  • Ability to lead the deployment and support of multiple Solutions, perhaps in parallel.
  • Ability to own project delivery within team, work as an independent contributor, and rally other individuals on the team to accomplish substantial tasks that cannot be completed independently.
  • Ability to mentor peers, delegate within team, handle project stakeholders, build relationships with other departments within Phaidra, and collaborate with their manager on the roadmap, backlog, and work planning.
  • Alignment with Phaidra's values: Agency, Velocity, Craft, & Truth.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Experience with rapidly prototyping new technologies and converting into commercially viable products.
  • Experience building, owning, and operating your own codebases/services.
  • Experience architecting services within cloud platforms.
  • Experience applying AI and ML in controls applications.
  • Experience with statistics, analytics, etc.
  • Experience with domain relevant optimization problems and solutions.
  • Familiarity with markup languages like Xml, Json, or Yaml.

Onboarding

In your first 30 days...

  • You will have a solid understanding of what Phaidra does and how we do it.
  • You will have met with team members across Phaidra and started building relationships that will help you be successful at your job.
  • You will have become proficient at navigating the Solution team’s processes and software tools.

By your first 60 days...

  • You will introduce yourself to our customers
  • You will understand our customer onboarding process
  • You will dig into Mort, our project workflow tool
  • You will build a toy system from scratch

By your first 90 days...

  • You will create and refine business processes

On being Remote

We take a thoughtful and intentional approach to remote collaboration. Inspired by pioneers like GitLab, we embrace proven best practices to foster an exceptional remote work environment. jobs.description:
Wann hast du zuletzt aus einem YouTube-Kanal einen SPIEGEL-Bestseller gemacht?

Bei uns ist das der Job. BrainBook macht Bücher mit einigen der größten Gaming-YouTuber Deutschlands, zum Beispiel LukasBS und EinfachGustaf: Romane, Comic-Romane, Reihen, Schwerpunkt Leser zwischen 8 und 14. Sechs Jahre alt, komplett remote, kein Gremium, kein Warten. Wir wirbeln eine Branche auf, die sich seit dreißig Jahren kaum bewegt hat, und nächstes Jahr bringen wir 16 Titel raus.

Dafür suchen wir die Person, die unsere Creator durch ihr Buchprojekt führt: vom ersten Konzept über den Launch bis zu dem Moment, in dem die Community das Buch in den Händen hält. Du kennst die Kanäle, du sprichst die Kampagne mit Creator und Management ab, du sorgst dafür, dass Marketingmaterial, Bonusmaterial und Integrationen rechtzeitig stehen, und du entwickelst mit unserer Programmleitung die nächsten Projekte. Organisiert genug, dass Deadlines halten. Nah genug an der Szene, dass Creator dir vertrauen.

Wenn du in deiner Agentur oder deinem Team die Person bist, die Creator anrufen, wenn es wichtig wird: Wir sollten reden.

Aufgaben

  • Du betreust unsere Creator und ihre Managements: Du kennst ihre Kanäle und ihre Community, bist die erste Ansprechperson für alles rund um Launch und Marketing und hältst den Kontakt vom ersten Konzept bis zu dem Tag, an dem das Buch erscheint, und darüber hinaus.
  • Du sprichst die Kampagne mit Creator und Management ab: Marketing-Calls, Integrationsplan mit Long-Form- und Short-Form-Formaten, Ankündigungs- und Launch-Termine. Du hältst den Plan in ClickUp nach, fasst nach, wenn etwas fehlt, und trägst die Ergebnisse je Integration in unseren Report ein.
  • Du bereitest jeden Launch nach unserer Checkliste vor: Timeline von der Ankündigung bis zum Erscheinungstermin, Vorbestellung, Gewinnspiele, Aktionen im Shop, auf Amazon und im TikTok Shop, abgestimmt mit Lektorat, Produktion und Design. Jedes Buch hat ein festes Launch-Budget, innerhalb dessen du Material und Freelancer selbst beauftragst. Jeden Freitag fasst du den Stand aller laufenden Launches in einem kurzen Report zusammen.
  • Du organisierst das Marketingmaterial mit dem Creator und unserem Design-Team: Teaser- und Shorts-Konzepte, Produktbilder, Creator-Boxen, Autogrammkarten, Dummy-Drucke und Bonusmaterial wie Poster, Maps oder Texture Packs. Du briefst Design-Team und externe Kreative, steuerst Revisionen und holst die Freigabe des Creators ein. Gestaltet wird im Design-Team, du hältst die Fäden.
  • Du bereitest mit unserer Programmleitung Pitches für neue Creator vor: Kanalanalyse, Konzeptskizze, Präsentation. Erstgespräche und Verhandlungen führt unser Geschäftsführer, du bist dabei, auch auf Messen und Events, und übernimmst mit der Zeit mehr.

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens ein Jahr Erfahrung im Influencer Marketing, im Creator- oder Talent-Management oder im Kampagnen- und Projektmanagement, zum Beispiel als Junior in einer Agentur, auf Markenseite oder in einem Creator-Management. Mehr ist willkommen, Voraussetzung ist es nicht.
  • Du hast schon mit Creatorn oder ihren Managements gearbeitet: Briefings, Freigaben, Termine, Nachfassen. Du bleibst dabei freundlich und verbindlich, schriftlich wie im Call.
  • Du kennst Long-Form und Short-Form aus der Praxis, kannst einen Kanal einschätzen (Zielgruppe, Formate, Reichweite, Qualität der Integrationen) und weißt, was Views, Watchtime, Klicks und Conversion über eine Integration aussagen.
  • Du hast schon mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig mit festen Deadlines organisiert, arbeitest im Home-Office selbstorganisiert und findest dich schnell in Projektmanagement-Systemen ein.
  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, Englisch in Wort und Schrift.
  • Ein Plus, kein Muss: eigene Kontakte zu Creatorn, Managements oder Agenturen, Gaming- oder Kids-Content-Affinität, Erfahrung mit den Kennzeichnungsregeln für Creator-Content.

Kein Ausschluss: Du musst nicht alles schon gemacht haben. Bücher, Buchhandel und Verlagsprozesse bringen wir dir bei. Was du mitbringst, ist das Gespür für Creator und ihre Communities und die Organisation, damit aus einer Idee ein Launch wird.

Benefits

  • Einstieg 36.000 bis 40.000 € im Jahr, je nach Erfahrung, plus Prämien ohne Deckel: für jeden komplett vorbereiteten Launch, für jede Kampagne, in der die vereinbarten Integrationen live gehen, und für jeden SPIEGEL-Bestseller zahlen wir extra, realistisch 4.000 bis 5.000 € im Jahr. Wer liefert, verdient hier mehr, und zwar automatisch, nicht nach Verhandlung.
  • Vollzeit, unbefristet, 100 % Home-Office, Firmensitz in Kiedrich.
  • 40 Stunden mit Arbeitszeitkonto: Plusstunden verfallen nicht, ab 37 Plusstunden zahlen wir automatisch aus.

Position Overview:

Ibility is seeking a detail-oriented Provisioning Specialist to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) enterprise provisioning capability. This position plays a critical role in ensuring users receive timely and accurate access to Oracle Health (Cerner Millennium) and associated clinical applications following deployment activities across the VA enterprise.

As a member of the provisioning operations team, the Provisioning Specialist will serve as a front-line resource responsible for receiving, validating, and processing user access requests while ensuring compliance with established identity and access management procedures. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced operational environment supporting mission-critical healthcare systems.

While supporting client delivery is the primary responsibility, this role also provides opportunities to contribute to Ibility's continued growth, operational excellence initiatives, and culture of innovation and continuous improvement.

Primary Responsibilities:

Access Request Processing

  • Receive, review, validate, and process user provisioning requests submitted through designated request management channels.
  • Validate user information and ensure required identifiers, including EDIPI, FedID, and SecID, are accurately captured and documented.
  • Review User Access Reports (UARs) and related system records to verify requested access does not already exist.
  • Submit service records and provisioning requests through Oracle Health eService and other authorized platforms.
  • Communicate request completion status, deficiencies, or required corrections to requesters and designated coordinators.

Provisioning Operations & Workflow Management

  • Process standard, ancillary, and special-case application provisioning requests in accordance with established procedures.
  • Maintain accurate request tracking information, including status updates, service record numbers, and resolution notes.
  • Monitor request queues and ensure timely processing in accordance with established service-level expectations.

Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) Execution & Continuous Improvement

  • Follow and maintain documented SOPs, work instructions, and provisioning guidelines for supported applications.
  • Identify process improvement opportunities and recommend enhancements to provisioning workflows and operational procedures.
  • Support knowledge-sharing initiatives and contribute to maintaining current operational documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and access management policies throughout the provisioning lifecycle.

Stakeholder Engagement & Customer Support

  • Partner with User Role Assignment Coordinators (URACs), system administrators, and requesters to resolve access-related issues.
  • Provide timely and professional customer service when addressing provisioning inquiries and deficiencies.
  • Follow up on incomplete requests and coordinate with stakeholders to obtain required approvals and documentation.
  • Maintain clear, accurate, and professional communications across all levels of the organization.

  • Experience performing data validation, data entry, and records review activities.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and Teams.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate across stakeholder groups.

About evermore

evermore is a technology company that administers Smart Benefits to connect people to products and services they need, when they need them, so they can live healthier lives. We partner with payers and retailers to deliver expansive benefits for things like healthy foods, OTC medications, or transportation. evermore is reinventing benefits administration so that everyone benefits with more value for each and better outcomes for all. evermore is a Series B stage company, backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Define Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Pinegrove Capital Partners, and Qiming Venture Partners.

The Role

Reporting to the Associate Director, Care Operations, you will own and run evermore’s Customer Care function day-to-day-a multi-vendor BPO environment supporting members and caregivers across multiple health plans and benefit program brands – partnering with Product, Implementation, Engineering, Finance and Customer Success to deliver consistent, high-quality care experiences at scale. This is a chance to build deep operational expertise across vendor governance, technology, quality and learning in a high-growth health benefits company where your work directly impacts members’ access to the benefits they need.

What You’ll Do

Working within an organization created at the intersection of health care, retail and financial technology, no two days will look the same. Typical responsibilities of the role include:

  • Running daily operations across BPO vendor partners — monitoring queue performance, SLA adherence, occupancy, and staffing levels in real time, holding partners accountable to quality, productivity, and compliance expectations across all client brands, and serving as the primary escalation point for operational issues
  • Managing BPO partner workforce against staffing requirements and volume forecasts — coordinating intraday adjustments, monitoring occupancy and service level adherence, and holding partners accountable to service level targets across all queues and skill groups using workforce management tooling
  • Owning Care’s technology stack day-to-day — administering and maintaining contact center systems (e.g., Zendesk), telephony tools (e.g., Amazon Connect), and contact center tooling; serving as the operational authority for system health, agent access, platform configuration, and issue resolution; partnering with IT and Engineering when technology changes are directed
  • Building and maintaining the Care learning infrastructure — new hire onboarding curriculum across BPO partners and internal team members, training materials and job aids built in evermore’s learning tools, and the Care knowledge base across all lines of business including CMS-regulated programs such as Medicare Advantage and Medicaid
  • Driving quality and continuous improvement — managing QA calibration sessions and coaching frameworks with BPO teams, analyzing performance data to identify gaps and translate insights into targeted interventions, and building and maintaining operational reporting including BPO scorecards and Care dashboards for internal stakeholders
  • Owning Care’s process documentation infrastructure — maintaining operational guides, escalation playbooks, and program-specific documentation ensuring content stays current as products, health plans, and compliance requirements evolve
  • Executing and contributing to operational projects — including platform migrations, new client launches, outbound campaigns, and process improvement initiatives — in close partnership with Product, Implementation, Engineering, and Customer Success teams
  • Serving as a capable, credible operational presence for internal stakeholders — representing Care in cross-functional meetings, contributing to new client onboarding, and communicating performance results and improvement plans with clarity and confidence

About You

While every candidate brings a unique resume and perspective, an ideal candidate will include:

  • 5+ years in contact center or care operations, with at least 2 years managing BPO vendors or frontline teams; healthcare, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, or benefits administration experience is a strong plus
  • Demonstrated BPO vendor accountability — SLA reviews, scorecard management, root cause diagnosis, and measurable performance improvement over time
  • Experience designing and delivering training programs or onboarding curriculum in a contact center or BPO environment — turning complex processes and regulatory requirements into clear, actionable agent resources
  • Hands-on experience building or maintaining a knowledge base, LMS, or e-learning content library; familiarity with authoring tools such as EasyGenerator or Articulate is a meaningful plus
  • Proficiency with contact center platforms (e.g., Amazon Connect), workforce management tooling (e.g., Assembled), contact center systems (e.g., Zendesk), and knowledge management platforms (e.g., Confluence) — you are the operational owner of the stack
  • Experience with QA programs — calibration sessions, coaching frameworks, and working with BPO partners and frontline supervisors to close performance gaps
  • Working knowledge of CMS-regulated programs such as Medicare Advantage or Medicaid — compliance demands, member communication standards, and audit requirements in a regulated environment
  • An analytics orientation — comfortable pulling and interpreting operational data to drive decisions, build reports, and present a clear performance narrative
  • A high-accountability, high-ownership mindset who thrives in ambiguity, manages multiple workstreams simultaneously, and takes problems through to resolution without handing them off
  • A systems thinker and collaborative leader who connects dots across operations, quality, training, and technology — coaching across levels, building inclusive environments, and driving sustainable improvements rather than one-time fixes
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience

Other Requirements

  • Occasional travel may be required from time to time as part of the role, for company events and business needs.
  • evermore is a remote-first, distributed workforce. Candidates should be comfortable with, and equipped to work within, a distributed remote team, including having reliable internet access and basic home office equipment. evermore will provide a work laptop, and mouse/keyboard upon request.
  • Legal authorization to work in the US is required. At this time, evermore will not consider candidates who need sponsorship, now or in the future.

jobs.excerpt: About Neura:Neura Health is a nationwide, doctor-led practice built to eliminate the barriers between patients and life-changing care.
jobs.description:
About Neura:

Neura Health is a nationwide, doctor-led practice built to eliminate the barriers between patients and life-changing care. As the country's leading virtual neurology clinic, we provide an all-in-one longitudinal platform where cutting-edge technology meets specialized expertise to manage the entire spectrum of neurological diseases. While traditional brick-and-mortar clinics are at a breaking point, forcing patients to endure dangerous 4-6 month wait times, Neura is scaling the nation’s largest virtual practice to deliver immediate access to the 145 million Americans in need. Through strategic partnerships with leading health systems, pharmaceutical innovators, and large clinics, as well as a direct-to-patient model, we are fundamentally transforming the referral landscape and reducing average wait time from 276 days to 5 days.

Our tech-enabled model provides a comprehensive, end-to-end experience that goes far beyond a standard consultation. We offer patients seamless access to personalized care plans and expert care navigation, ensuring no one has to manage their journey alone. This mission is powered by our multidisciplinary specialized care teams, which include world-class physicians, nurse practitioners, physician associates, and dedicated care coaches. We leverage AI-powered workflow optimization and continuous monitoring for everything from chronic headaches and epilepsy to complex memory disorders. Backed by $22M in funding from world-class investors, we are not just improving neurology; we are revolutionizing it. We are looking for purpose-driven innovators to join us in making high-quality brain health a reality for everyone.

About the Role

Neura Health is expanding its care model into behavioral health, and we’re looking for our first Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP) to help us build this vertical from the ground up. Given the high prevalence of co-morbid psychiatric conditions among our neurology patient population — including anxiety, depression, OCD, and PTSD alongside diagnoses like migraine, epilepsy, and memory disorders — this role is both clinically vital and strategically critical.

As the first PMHNP, you will provide high-quality telehealth psychiatric care to Neura patients, working within our multidisciplinary care team. This is a part-time contract role (minimum 8 hours per week) with significant growth potential as we scale our behavioral health vertical. Multi-state licensure is strongly preferred — the more states you are licensed in, the greater your impact.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive telehealth psychiatric evaluations, diagnoses, and treatment planning for Neura’s neurology patient population
  • Prescribe and manage psychiatric medications, monitoring for efficacy and side effects in the context of neurological co-morbidities
  • Collaborate closely with Neura’s neurologists, nurse practitioners, and care coaches to deliver integrated, whole-patient care
  • Document all clinical encounters in the EMR accurately and in a timely manner, adhering to Neura’s documentation standards
  • Participate in care team case reviews, clinical huddles, and ongoing quality improvement initiatives
  • Maintain multi-state licensure and practice within your licensed states; actively pursue additional state licensure as the patient panel grows
  • Dedicate a minimum of 8 clinical hours per week to Neura, with the expectation to scale hours as the behavioral health vertical expands
  • Help shape and inform Neura’s behavioral health clinical protocols, workflows, and patient experience as our first PMHNP hire
  • Stay current with evidence-based practices in psychiatry, telepsychiatry, and the intersection of neurology and behavioral health

Requirements

  • Current, unrestricted PMHNP licensure in at least New York state; multi-state licensure strongly preferred (the more states, the better)
  • Board certification as a PMHNP-BC (or ARNP with psychiatric specialty)
  • Active DEA registration and prescriptive authority; ability to obtain DEA registration in additional states
  • Minimum 2 years of clinical experience as a PMHNP, with prior telehealth experience strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated experience treating patients with psychiatric co-morbidities alongside chronic conditions, ideally in neurology, primary care, or integrated care settings
  • Proficiency with electronic health records (EHR/EMR) and telehealth platforms
  • Ability to commit to a minimum of 8 patient care hours per week, with flexibility to scale as volume grows
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for both patient care and cross-functional team collaboration
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection and a HIPAA-compliant workspace for telehealth sessions

Mindset & Approach

  • Genuinely passionate about caring for neurology patients and understanding how psychiatric co-morbidities affect their neurological health outcomes
  • High ownership mentality — you proactively identify gaps in patient care and take initiative to address them
  • Excited about building something new; you’re energized by being the first rather than intimidated by it
  • Collaborative and low-ego; you work fluidly across a multidisciplinary team and build trust quickly
  • Deeply mission-driven and excited about expanding access to high-quality mental health care within a neurology-focused model
  • Patient and adaptable as processes evolve — you understand that early-stage means imperfect and you help make it better
  • Ready to roll up your sleeves and jump in wherever needed — no task too big or too small

Bonus Points

  • Experience working with patients with epilepsy, traumatic brain injury, MS, dementia, or other neurological diagnoses
  • Familiarity with Neura’s clinical model or prior experience at a digital health or virtual-first practice
  • Experience with collaborative practice agreements or working under a supervising physician in states that require it
  • Interest or experience in clinical protocol development, quality improvement, or training other clinicians
  • Spanish language proficiency or other multilingual skills

Remote | Contract (1099) | Part-Time with Growth Potential

Compensation: $75–$95/hour

Neura Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Culture: About Being a “Neuron” Neura is building a category-defining neurology company, and we’re doing it with a team that’s all-in. We move with urgency, we take ownership end-to-end, and we hold an extremely high bar because the work is real and the impact is personal. We’re here to raise the standard of care and deliver a patient experience that is world-class.

You’ll thrive here if you have an unwavering curiosity to do right by the patient and you’re energized by delivering a radically better patient experience, not incremental improvement. If you’re the kind of person who sees what could be better and can’t let it go, who learns fast, executes with precision, and follows through to outcomes, you’ll fit right in. You’ll be surrounded by a highly committed, humble, and inspiring team that challenges each other directly, supports each other deeply, and gets better every week. If you want real responsibility, real velocity, and the chance to build something transformative from the ground up, this is the place for you.

About the Founders:

  • Liz Burstein is the CEO and was previously Head of Product at Maven Clinic, Director of Product at Zocdoc and Senior Product Lead at LinkedIn. She has fifteen years of experience in the tech industry, and a wealth of knowledge in the health tech domain.
  • Sameer Madan is the CTO and was previously an engineer at Facebook for 9 years. At Facebook, Sameer was the technical lead for Live Video, and built several well known products such as Facebook Mentions, threaded-ranked comments, and more.

Company Description

Swiftly is on a mission to help cities move more efficiently. We are the leading transit data platform for agencies to share real-time passenger information, manage day-to-day operations, and improve service performance. Today, over 200 transit agencies in 12 countries – including LA Metro, MARTA, SEPTA, and MBTA – rely on Swiftly to improve on-time performance by up to 40% and increase passenger information accuracy by up to 50%. The result is better service reliability, increased ridership, and more efficient transit operations.
Even though Swiftly's HQ office is located in San Francisco, CA, we are open to candidates in most locations across the U.S. as well as Ontario and British Columbia, Canada. At this time we are unable to provide Visa sponsorship.

About the Professional Services Team

The Professional Services team is part of the broader Customer Success department at Swiftly, working to ensure customers are happy and finding immense value in the tools that Swiftly provides.

The Customer Success department comprises Implementation Managers, Account Managers, and Technical Support Representatives. This department is on the front line — the first point of contact for customers who have questions, are encountering issues, or need support during the implementation phase of our relationship. When problems arise, we ensure that individual customers are heard and that their issues are cared for, and we apply a keen analytical eye to spot trends and communicate problems proactively with the product team. We are passionate about improving mobility in the communities we serve, and we work side by side with transit agencies and operators to ensure their projects are impactful. We love the human aspect of our work and thrive on getting creative to solve problems or boost network performance. The Customer Success org is responsible for everything post-sale, and the Implementations team is a critical part of starting our customers on the right foot.

About the Role

Reporting to Stan Parkford, the Customer Training and Adoption Specialist will be responsible for designing, delivering, and evolving customer training programs to enhance adoption and proficiency across our customer agencies. You'll create dynamic, role-based learning experiences, provide personalized training sessions, and develop scalable educational resources to support users at every stage of their journey — from pre-sales through implementation to ongoing education. Central to this work is structured change management: helping agencies reorient their teams around optimized workflows and realize the full value of Swiftly as a core part of how they do their jobs.

This role will work closely with Implementation Managers, Account Managers, Solutions Engineers, and Product Managers.

This is a remote position that will require frequent travel — 8 to 14 trips per year are expected.

What You'll Do

Create a dynamic training curriculum and change management program

  • Develop and refine a dynamic training curriculum tailored to customers' technical aptitude (beginner, moderate, advanced), department, role, persona, and agency size.
  • Design and execute structured change management programs grounded in best practices, helping agencies move beyond onboarding to genuinely reorienting their workflows around Swiftly — so staff adopt it as a core tool for their job functions, not just a new system to learn.

Deliver personalized training across the customer journey

  • Lead remote and on-site training for transit agencies during implementation (new customers and upsells) in coordination with Swiftly's Implementation Managers.
  • Support post-implementation training for existing customers in collaboration with Account Managers.
  • Training sessions include creating and presenting materials, guiding users through Swiftly's solutions via live demonstrations, and answering product-related questions ranging from basic to technical — including how underlying data sources and integrations affect what customers see in the platform.

Lead internal enablement on new products and features

  • Develop and deliver comprehensive training sessions for internal teams — including Implementation Managers, Customer Success Managers, and Account Managers — to ensure deep understanding of new products and features.
  • Collaborate with Product, Marketing, and Sales teams to gather insights and align on key messaging, feature benefits, and use cases.
  • Act as a subject matter expert (SME) for new products and features, providing ongoing support and clarification to internal teams as needed.

Develop and maintain product education and knowledge base resources

  • Create resources including (but not limited to): training videos (product-, feature-, or persona-specific), knowledge base articles, and written workflow and standard operating procedure guidance.
  • Maintain an up-to-date product education library, ensuring content aligns with evolving Swiftly features and workflows.
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate content development — drafting, refining, and maintaining training materials, knowledge base articles, and video scripts at scale without sacrificing quality.

Design and lead 1:many product education opportunities

  • Design and facilitate live webinars and workshops to drive adoption of new features and best practices.
  • Identify trends in customer challenges and proactively create educational opportunities for broader audiences.

Success Metrics

You will be measured by the impact of training in two key areas:

Product Adoption

We prioritize compassion, integrity, and excellence in all our interactions and operations.

Here at Medsien, our Certified Medical Assistants are able to take their clinical experience, knowledge, insight, and empathy to improve patients' health care, experiences, and outcomes. Comprehensive chronic care management benefits patients with 24/7 access to physicians and clinical staff who can meet their urgent and ongoing needs. CCM also benefits practices by electronically capturing all patient interactions for real-time continuity of care.

Patient enrollment is the first step in helping our patients and providers manage their chronic conditions more effectively. If patients aren’t taking advantage of our Chronic Care Management (CCM) and Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) programs, they are missing out on a key tool in managing their Chronic illnesses. Our goal is for patients to feel as comfortable with us as they do when visiting their provider's office. We prioritize compassionate quality care.

As an Enrollment Specialist you will educate and enroll eligible patients from our established clinic partnerships. You will connect with eligible patients through outbound calls, resulting in enrollments to achieve your weekly goals. Please note that having national certification in Medical Assisting from AAMA, NHA, NCCT, NAHP or similar is a hard job requirement and any single-state certifications, diplomas or completion certificates do not qualify.

You will receive comprehensive training on CCM/RPM program details, enrollment processes, and communication techniques to ensure you are well-prepared for the role.

Flex is building the AI-native private bank for super premium, closely held business owners.

We are re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs. From the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, financial operations, all rebuilt from the ground up as a single intelligent system.

Since launching publicly in September 2023, we have scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.

Our customers are affluent business owners with $3M to $200M in revenue. The backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. We are replacing the outdated banks and fragmented tools they are stuck with. The opportunity is a roughly $1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. We are building toward $100B+ in enterprise value by delivering a product that is fundamentally better, not incrementally improved.

Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.

What we hold ourselves to: mission-critical problems, high bar low ego, speed over comfort, enduring impact.

Locations: San Francisco, New York, Miami, remote. Open to candidates in Canada, Mexico, the United States, Brazil, and Colombia.

The Role

You will own Flex's card programs end to end. We are running a meaningful annualized credit program today. We are launching multiple new card products in the next two quarters across credit, stablecoin, and rewards. Your job is to scale this from one major program to five-plus and take total volume across the portfolio up by more than an order of magnitude.

This is not a card fulfillment seat. This is the owner of every layer of our card stack: ledger, processing, servicing, fulfillment, BIN sponsor relationships, network relationships, and the operational discipline that lets us run multiple programs concurrently without seams.

We want someone who has personally spun up a card program from scratch, not as a secondary contributor. Someone who can sit in a meeting with a major processor or card network, hear a vendor explanation, and call out exactly where the story is bullshit. Someone who knows what FTS, ARI, DPS, BINs, and the rest of the alphabet actually mean and where vendors hide behind acronyms.

You will partner closely with your engineering counterpart and be on a small team initially. Your first job after landing is to tell us who you need to hire next. This is a business unit builder seat.

What you will do

Own every layer of Flex's card programs: ledger, processing, servicing, fulfillment, BIN sponsor management, network relationships.

Lead processor strategy and the direct network relationship. Hold vendors accountable. Drive the technical and commercial negotiations.

Build the operational infrastructure that supports five concurrent card programs across credit, stablecoin, and rewards.

Architect the path to scale the portfolio by more than 20x. Build the operating model that makes that scale possible without breaking customer experience.

Recruit the next layer of the card programs team as the function grows. You will tell us who we need to hire and when.

Translate the technical complexity of card issuing into clear product decisions for the rest of the company. We have struggled to communicate the now program, the transition, and the future program. Fixing that is part of your job.

What you will need

You have personally spun up at least one card program from scratch as the primary owner. If you were the secondary contributor on someone else's program, this is not the seat for you.

Hands-on depth across ledger, processing, servicing, and fulfillment. You know what each of these is, who the vendors are, and where the operational risk lives.

Deep familiarity with BIN sponsor dynamics, issuer processor mechanics, and card network rules. You can hold a real conversation about a processor migration or a network compliance issue.

Senior plus. Typically 8 to 12 years of experience. Title is not the point. Building the business unit is.

You are willing to be the only person on this for a stretch and then build the function around you.

You can read vendor decks and decide what is real and what is sales theater.

jobs.description:
audibene ist das am schnellsten wachsende Hörgeräte-Unternehmen aller Zeiten. Wir wissen, dass gutes Hören die Lebensqualität entscheidend erhöht. Mit unserem einzigartigen digitalen Geschäftsmodell haben wir die Art und Weise der Hörgeräte-Versorgung revolutioniert.

Unser Ursprung und Hauptsitz liegen in Deutschland. In den letzten 12 Jahren haben wir uns zu einem international tätigen Unternehmen mit mehr als 1.200 Mitarbeiter:innen entwickelt: an 9 Standorten weltweit von Berlin bis Seoul.

Um gut leben zu können, ist es wichtig, gut hören zu können. Das ist es, woran wir bei audibene glauben. Unser Ziel ist es, das Leben unserer Kund:innen nachhaltig zu verändern. Auf dieser spannenden Reise brauchen wir deine Hilfe.

Wir suchen neue ExpertInnen, die deutschlandweit im Home Office für uns tätig sind.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du steuerst den gesamten Vertriebsprozess: vom Erstkontakt (Warmakquise) über die tiefgehende, individuelle Beratung bis hin zum Verkaufsabschluss.
  • Du bleibst über die gesamte Beratungszeit hinweg mit unseren Partnerakustiker:innen im Austausch und gewährleistest damit den Hörerfolg unserer Kund:innen als Teil des beidseitigen Beratungsansatzes.
  • Für deinen persönlichen Erfolg behältst du den Überblick über deine KPIs und setzt deine ambitionierte und strukturierte Arbeitsweise gekonnt ein.
  • Deine Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen hilft dir dabei, deine Aufgaben effizient zu koordinieren und so die bestmögliche Beratung für deine Kund:innen zu garantieren.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast Berufserfahrung im Vertrieb oder in der Kundenberatung, bestenfalls mit erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten oder Dienstleistungen.
  • Du bist ein passioniertes Verkaufstalent und behältst die Bedürfnisse deiner Kund:innen immer im Blick.
  • Du gibst bei einem ersten "Nein" nicht auf, weil du die Herausforderung genießt und deine eigenen Ziele übertreffen möchtest.
  • Dich spornt die Arbeit im Team an, du hast Spaß daran dich und andere zu motivieren.
  • Du fühlst dich in einem dynamischen, schnellwachsenden Umfeld wohl.
  • Du hast Lust durch deine Arbeit die Akustikbranche durch Digitalisierung nachhaltig zu verändern.

Was wir bieten

  • Bei audibene wirst du täglich unsere Kund:innen durch besseres Hören glücklich machen.
  • Du arbeitest 5 Tage die Woche im Home-Office, mit einem Wohnsitz in Deutschland.
  • Als Teil des audibene Teams triffst du dich regelmäßig zu Team-Events und gemeinsamen Off-Sites, sowie zum audibene Wandertag.
  • Damit du immer gut an dein Ziel kommst übernehmen wir für alle Mitarbeiter:innen das Deutschland-Ticket.
  • Um fit und gesund zu bleiben, hast du mit Urban Sports Zugang zu über 50.000 Fitnessstudios und Wellbeing-Einrichtungen.
  • Dich erwartet ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit einem attraktiven Grundgehalt und ungedeckelter Provision.
  • Zum Start bieten wir dir ein detailliertes, strukturiertes und fachlich fundiertes Onboarding im Rahmen unserer Sales Academy.
  • Uns liegt deine persönliche Weiterentwicklung am Herzen, daher gibt es ein umfangreiches Angebot zur Weiterentwicklung durch Weiterentwicklungsprogramme, Trainings und Coachings.

Wenn du also Lust hast, Teil eines motivierten und zielstrebigen Teams zu werden, das die Welt ein bisschen glücklicher machen möchte, dann bewirb dich jetzt!

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (m/w/x)
jobs.excerpt: Deine Rolle bei unsWir suchen einen neuen SDR zur Verstärkung des Workist Go-to-Market-Teams.
jobs.description:
Deine Rolle bei uns

Wir suchen einen neuen SDR zur Verstärkung des Workist Go-to-Market-Teams. Bei Workist arbeiten wir nach einem modernen, interdisziplinären Modell und haben Marketing und SDRs in einem einzigen Team zusammengefasst, das für alle Top-of-Funnel-Aktivitäten verantwortlich ist. Diese Struktur ermöglicht es uns, Kampagnen ganzheitlich durchzuführen und auf Intent Signale zu reagieren, anstatt den ganzen Tag lang auf Cold Calling zu setzen. Als SDR berichtest du direkt an den VP of Marketing.

In den letzten 5 Jahren haben wir bei Workist einen gut funktionierenden Inbound-Prozess aufgebaut, um die Pipeline und den Umsatz zu steigern. Seit Anfang des Jahres konzentrieren wir uns verstärkt darauf, auch einen Outbound-Prozess aufzubauen. Wir suchen nun ein neues Teammitglied, um auf unseren ersten Erfolgen aufzubauen und unsere Outbound-Aktivitäten als weiteren erfolgreichen Kanal zu etablieren.

Workist wird von über 150 B2B-Unternehmen genutzt und ist ein führender Anbieter von KI-Softwarelösungen im Vertriebsbereich. Unser Produkt ist bei potenziellen Kunden sehr gefragt und das Feedback des Marktes ist überwältigend positiv.

Diese Position ist ideal für jemanden, der bereits erste Erfahrungen in einer kundenorientierten Rolle gesammelt hat und eine erfolgreiche Karriere im Vertrieb starten möchte. Wenn du in leanen Teams gut arbeiten kannst, gerne lernst und Initiative zeigst, dann ist diese Position genau das Richtige für dich.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Multi-Channel Multi-Touch Outbound-Kampagnen
    • Kontaktaufnahme mit Zielkunden per E-Mail, Telefon und LinkedIn
    • Aufbau von Multi-Channel-Kampagnen mit strukturierten Nurturing- und Follow-up-Prozessen
    • Reagieren auf Buying Intent Signale und individuell angepasste Kommunikation mit Prospects
  • Qualifizieren wie ein Profi
    • Konvertiere Prospects in hochqualifizierte Sales Demos, die von den AEs übernommen werden können
    • Optimiere dein Qualifizierungsskript kontinuierlich basierend auf dem Feedback von Prospects und anderen Go-to-Market-Teams
    • Führe A/B-Tests durch, um deine Aktivitäten weiter zu optimieren
  • Automatisierung und datengestützte Entscheidungsfindung
    • Beherrsche HubSpot, Clay und weitere Tools sicher, um so viel Zeit wie möglich für die eigentliche Kundenarbeit zu haben
    • Nutze Buying Intent Signale, um die Kaufbereitschaft von Prospects zu beurteilen und relevante Accounts zum richtigen Zeitpunkt zu kontaktieren
    • Verwende einen datengestützten Ansatz in deiner Arbeit, um zu verstehen, was am besten funktioniert
  • Baue eine relevante Zielgruppe auf LinkedIn auf
    • Vernetze dich strategisch mit relevanten Zielpersonen
    • Teile Thought Leadership Content von Workist mit deinem Netzwerk
    • Optional: Baue deine eigene Marke auf

Unsere Benefits & Kultur

  • WorKi Tower: Unser hippes Office im Herzen der Stadt über 6 Etagen lädt dich zum professionellen Arbeiten an einem ergonomischen Arbeitsplatz ein und lässt dir Freiraum für deine Kreativität. Unsere eigene Workist-Lounge wartet mit einer gemütlichen Atmosphäre inkl. Kaffee, Drinks und einem Vitaminkorb auf kurze oder längere Kreativpausen auf dich. Spiele Tischtennis, Dart oder Nintendo, um deinen Kopf frei zu bekommen und um dich mit anderen Teams auszutauschen.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Gestaltet deinen Arbeitstag mit unseren flexiblen Arbeitszeiten. Du hast wichtige Termine am Morgen oder Abend? Kein Problem, profitiere von der Arbeitszeit-Flexibilität.
  • Office, Remote & Workation: Du entscheidest selbst und hast auch hier die flexible Wahl zwischen hippem Office oder Remote von deinem Lieblingsort aus! Wir stellen dir frei, 4 Wochen im Jahr auch aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten. Deine State-of-the-Art Hardware wird dich auf deinen Wegen begleiten!
  • Come-Together: Let’s play together - let’s celebrate together! Lass den Arbeitsalltag bei einem kühlen Getränk in unserer Lounge ausklingen oder genieße die Zeit mit deinen Kollegen beim Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier oder unseren quarterly Teamevents.
  • Bleib fit und gesund: Deine Fitness ist uns wichtig, deshalb nimm an unserem wöchentlichen RunningLunch teil und connecte dich dabei mit deinen Kollegen. Work-Life Balance und Reduzierung deines Stressniveaus inklusive.
  • Bleib mobil: Wähle zwischen Deutschlandticket Job und einem JobRad Zuschuss und sei damit mobil in ganz Berlin und/oder Deutschland.
  • Sei sozial: Für dein Herzensprojekt oder um dich sozial und ehrenamtlich zu engagieren, unterstützen wir dich mit 3 zusätzlichen “Social Days”.
  • Dein Entwicklungspotenzial: Wir ermöglichen dir, dich mit einem Personal Development Budget von 1.000,00 EUR pro Jahr weiterzubilden.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.excerpt: DescriptionWho we are? Surecomp® is the market-leading provider of digital trade finance solutions for corporates and financial institutions.
jobs.description:
Description

Who we are?

Surecomp® is the market-leading provider of digital trade finance solutions for corporates and financial institutions. An industry pioneer for more than thirty-five years, we enable seamless, sustainable trade by breaking down barriers and fostering collaboration. Our award-winning portfolio of cloud and on-premises solutions streamlines the trade finance lifecycle for frictionless transaction processing, enhanced risk mitigation, compliance, decision support, and growth. Underpinned by global offices and an extensive partner network, our prestigious customer footprint spans over eighty countries across the world. For more information visit surecomp.com.

Our Vision and Mission

We believe that Sustainable global trade promotes growth and improves people’s lives. The better the world trades, the better society is.

Our Mission is to enable seamless sustainable trade for everyone by removing barriers and facilitating collaboration.

﻿About the Role

We are looking for a highly motivated and energetic Sales Development Representative to join our global commercial organization and support our sales growth across Europe.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is at the beginning of their sales career and wants to grow within the world of B2B SaaS, fintech, and digital trade finance. The role is highly hands-on and requires strong sales orientation, persistence, sharp communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple leads and follow-ups at the same time.

As an SDR, you will play a key role in identifying, engaging, qualifying, and nurturing leads across different market segments. You will work with both inbound leads who have already shown interest in Surecomp, as well as outbound leads from our existing databases, event attendee lists, and targeted prospecting activities.

The role will support Surecomp’s solutions across both financial institutions and corporates. This means engaging with banking professionals, corporate treasury teams, and other relevant stakeholders, understanding their initial interest or pain points, creating curiosity around Surecomp’s value proposition, and helping move qualified leads toward the sales team.

The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, commercially minded, comfortable communicating by phone and email, and able to handle objections in a professional and confident way. This is a role for someone who understands that successful sales development requires consistency, follow-up, curiosity, and strong attention to detail.

Location

Remote, Europe.

Preference will be given to candidates based in Germany, Netherlands or England.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Engage with inbound leads who have contacted Surecomp or shown interest in our solutions, qualify their potential, and ensure timely and professional follow-up.
  • Conduct proactive outbound outreach to potential leads across Europe through email, phone, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels.
  • Support pre-event sales activities by working with attendee lists, identifying relevant prospects, reaching out before events, and scheduling meetings between prospects and Surecomp’s sales representatives.
  • Manage post-event follow-ups with prospects, ensure all interactions are properly tracked, and help move relevant leads forward in the sales process.
  • Maintain strong ownership of lead management, making sure each lead is tracked, updated, followed up on, and clearly documented at every stage.
  • Work closely with the sales team to qualify leads and transfer them once they become relevant opportunities.
  • Learn and communicate Surecomp’s value proposition clearly, including our solutions for banks and corporates, and tailor the initial pitch based on the type of prospect.
  • Engage with different types of stakeholders, including banking professionals and corporate representatives.
  • Handle initial questions and objections from prospects in a confident and professional way, while knowing when to involve the relevant sales team members.
  • Use Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and other sales tools to manage outreach activity, track leads, and support pipeline creation.
  • Work with large databases of potential prospects and continuously support the creation of new meetings and sales opportunities.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and other commercial functions to support lead generation efforts.

Requirements

Knowledge and Experience

  • At least 1-2 years of experience in a sales-related, customer-facing, call center, customer retention, business development, or sales development role.
  • Strong interest in building a career in sales, with clear commercial orientation and the ability to identify potential business opportunities.
  • Experience communicating with customers or prospects by phone and email, with the ability to build interest, ask relevant questions, and manage objections.
  • Ability to work in a structured and organized way, manage multiple leads in parallel, and maintain strong follow-up discipline.
  • Fluent written and verbal communication skills in both German and English.
  • High level of energy, persistence, curiosity, and motivation to succeed in a target-driven commercial environment.
  • Ability to learn a complex B2B SaaS and fintech offering and translate it into clear, simple, and engaging messaging for prospects.
  • Comfortable working in a hands-on role that includes repetitive outreach, lead tracking, phone calls, emails, follow-ups, and detailed CRM updates.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while staying closely aligned with global sales and commercial teams.

Advantages

  • Previous experience as an SDR, BDR, or similar sales development role in a B2B SaaS company.
  • Experience working with Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or other CRM and sales engagement tools.
  • Experience working with event-based lead generation, including pre-event outreach, meeting scheduling, and post-event follow-up.
  • Previous experience in fintech, banking, financial services, treasury, corporate finance, or enterprise software.
  • Experience working in an international or global sales environment.
  • Additional European languages.

Skills

  • Strong sales orientation, commercial curiosity, and high energy.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Ability to manage outbound outreach, inbound leads, follow-ups, and objections.
  • Strong multitasking, organization, and CRM discipline.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, global environment.

jobs.excerpt: Commercial Roofing EstimatorPosition OverviewWe are seeking an experienced Commercial Roofing Estimator to join our commercial roofing team in a fully remote capacity.
jobs.description:
Commercial Roofing Estimator

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Commercial Roofing Estimator to join our commercial roofing team in a fully remote capacity.

This is a highly specialised estimating position focused on commercial roofing takeoffs, estimating, and bid preparation.

The successful candidate will independently review commercial construction plans, specifications, drawings, and bid documents; complete detailed roofing takeoffs; develop accurate labour and material estimates; identify scope requirements and risks; and prepare competitive bids for submission.

This is not a general construction estimating position. We are specifically seeking a professional with demonstrated commercial roofing estimating expertise who understands commercial roofing systems, installation requirements, roofing components, labour production, material requirements, and the details that can materially affect the profitability and competitiveness of a bid.

The ideal candidate can take a project from a commercial bid platform, determine whether the opportunity is appropriate to pursue, download and analyse plans and specifications, complete the roofing takeoff, develop the estimate, identify scope gaps and risks, and deliver a complete bid package by the required deadline.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Roofing Takeoffs & Plan Review

  • Review commercial construction plans, specifications, drawings, addenda, scopes of work, and bid documents.

  • Perform accurate and detailed material and scope takeoffs for commercial roofing projects.

  • Identify roofing areas, system types, dimensions, quantities, assemblies, transitions, penetrations, and related components.

  • Interpret architectural, structural, mechanical, and roofing details as they relate to the roofing scope.

  • Review project specifications to identify applicable roofing requirements, standards, manufacturers, assemblies, and installation requirements.

  • Identify exclusions, alternates, allowances, owner requirements, and other conditions that may affect the roofing estimate.

  • Review addenda and revised documents and incorporate changes into the takeoff and estimate.

Commercial Roofing Systems

Demonstrate the ability to estimate and quantify commercial roofing systems and components, including:

  • TPO

  • PVC

  • EPDM

  • Built-up roofs

  • Metal roofing

  • Roof insulation

  • Tapered insulation

  • Roof coatings

  • Sheet metal

  • Flashing

  • Copings

  • Drains

  • Edge metal

  • Adhesives

  • Sealants

  • Roof accessories

  • Other commercial roofing components and accessories

Estimating & Bid Preparation

  • Prepare detailed estimates for labour, materials, equipment, accessories, subcontracted requirements, and other project costs.

  • Apply appropriate labour production rates and installation requirements.

  • Research and incorporate current material and labour pricing when necessary.

  • Obtain or validate supplier pricing and material costs as required.

  • Develop competitive and accurate commercial roofing bids.

  • Prepare bid proposals based on project plans, specifications, and scope.

  • Review completed estimates for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before submission.

  • Identify cost drivers and estimating assumptions that may materially affect the bid.

  • Ensure estimates accurately reflect the actual roofing scope rather than relying solely on generic allowances or assumptions.

  • Provide allowances post-estimate.

Bid Platform & Opportunity Identification

Independently navigate commercial construction bidding and plan-room platforms, including:

  • ConstructConnect

  • Bid Express

  • Dodge Construction Network

  • Similar construction bid and plan-room platforms

Responsibilities include:

  • Locate relevant commercial roofing opportunities.

  • Review project information and determine whether opportunities are appropriate to pursue.

  • Download plans, specifications, addenda, and other bid documents.

  • Review project requirements and identify the applicable roofing scope.

  • Track bid dates, deadlines, and document updates.

  • Identify opportunities that align with business capabilities, market strategy, and commercial roofing expertise.

Scope Review & Risk Identification

  • Identify discrepancies, conflicts, omissions, or missing information in plans and specifications.

  • Identify scope gaps that could create cost exposure.

  • Flag unusual or high-risk project requirements before bid submission.

  • Identify requirements that may require clarification from the general contractor, architect, manufacturer, supplier, or commercial team.

  • Prepare clear questions or requests for clarification when information is incomplete or inconsistent.

  • Identify exclusions, qualifications, alternates, and assumptions that should be reflected in the estimate or bid.

  • Communicate material estimating risks to the commercial team before submission.

Organisation & Bid Management

  • Maintain organised digital estimating files, takeoffs, pricing documentation, and supporting information.

  • Manage multiple commercial roofing bids simultaneously.

  • Prioritise bids according to deadlines, project value, strategic importance, and pursuit criteria.

  • Meet established bid deadlines consistently.

  • Maintain accurate records of bid status and estimating activity.

  • Provide regular updates regarding active estimates, upcoming deadlines, outstanding information, and completed bids.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated professional experience estimating commercial roofing projects.

  • Strong understanding of commercial roofing systems, materials, components, and installation methods.

  • Proven experience performing detailed construction takeoffs.

  • Ability to independently read and interpret commercial construction plans and specifications.

  • Experience preparing competitive and accurate commercial roofing bids.

  • Strong understanding of commercial roofing labour and material requirements.

  • Ability to accurately quantify roofing systems and associated components.

  • Strong attention to detail and a high standard of estimating accuracy.

  • Ability to identify scope gaps, inconsistencies, exclusions, and estimating risks.

  • Ability to manage multiple bids and strict deadlines independently.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to work effectively with a commercial roofing team in a fully remote environment.

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently without constant supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of commercial roofing estimating experience.

  • Experience estimating large commercial roofing projects.

  • Experience with both public and private commercial construction bids.

  • Experience using ConstructConnect, Bid Express, Dodge Construction Network, or similar platforms.

  • Advanced experience with Bluebeam Revu and/or PlanSwift.

  • Experience with On-Screen Takeoff, Procore, or similar construction software.

  • Experience with roofing estimating databases.

  • Experience working with roofing supplier pricing and material databases.

  • Strong understanding of labour production rates and commercial roofing installation requirements.

  • Extensive experience with TPO, PVC, EPDM, metal roofing, and other commercial roofing systems.

  • Experience estimating complex roof assemblies, insulation systems, sheet metal, edge metal, flashing, penetrations, and other commercial roofing components.

Software & Technology

The candidate should have strong working experience with digital construction takeoff and estimating technology, including:

Primary Platforms:

  • Bluebeam Revu

  • ServiceTitan

  • PlanSwift

  • On-Screen Takeoff

  • Procore or similar construction software

Bid & Plan-Room Platforms:

  • ConstructConnect

  • Bid Express

  • Dodge Construction Network

  • Similar commercial construction bidding platforms

Experience with multiple takeoff, estimating, plan-room, and construction management platforms is a strong advantage.

Remote Work Requirements

Because this is a fully remote position, the successful candidate must have:

  • Reliable high-speed internet.

  • Appropriate computer hardware capable of efficiently handling large construction plans and digital takeoff software.

  • Consistent availability during established working hours.

  • Ability to meet strict bid deadlines without direct supervision.

  • A professional and distraction-controlled remote work environment.

  • Strong written communication skills.

  • Ability to communicate efficiently with the commercial team.

  • High levels of organisation and self-management.

  • Ability to provide regular updates on estimating activity, active bids, completed estimates, and upcoming deadlines.

Performance Expectations

Performance will be evaluated based on measurable estimating and bid-production results, including:

  • Takeoff Accuracy: Roofing quantities and scope are accurately identified and quantified.

  • Estimate Accuracy: Labour, material, equipment, accessories, and other applicable costs are properly incorporated.

  • Bid Volume: Consistently completes an appropriate number of qualified commercial roofing bids based on workload and opportunity volume.

  • Deadline Compliance: Maintains a high percentage of bids completed and submitted before required deadlines.

  • Estimate Quality: Estimates are complete, organised, clearly documented, and commercially usable.

  • Risk Identification: Consistently identifies scope gaps, discrepancies, exclusions, unusual requirements, and potential cost risks.

  • Responsiveness: Responds promptly to questions and requests from the commercial team.

  • Opportunity Prioritisation: Focuses estimating resources on high-value and strategically relevant projects.

  • Documentation: Maintains consistent, organised, and easily accessible estimating files and supporting documentation.

  • Independence: Demonstrates the ability to manage the estimating workload with minimal supervision.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means the commercial team can confidently rely on the estimator to:

  1. Find and evaluate relevant commercial roofing opportunities.

  2. Quickly understand the project and determine whether it is appropriate to pursue.

  3. Thoroughly review plans, specifications, addenda, and bid requirements.

  4. Complete a precise commercial roofing takeoff.

  5. Accurately quantify roofing systems, materials, accessories, and labour requirements.

  6. Identify scope gaps and potential estimating risks before they become costly problems.

  7. Produce a competitive and commercially sound estimate.

  8. Clearly document assumptions, exclusions, alternates, and qualifications.

  9. Complete the estimate ahead of the bid deadline.

  10. Deliver a bid package the commercial team can use with confidence.

The successful candidate will function as a commercial roofing estimating specialist and technical resource, rather than a general administrative or general construction employee.

jobs.title: Property Rights Attorney
jobs.excerpt: You: An entrepreneurial freedom fighter with a passion for property rights in courtrooms across the nation.
jobs.description:
You: An entrepreneurial freedom fighter with a passion for property rights in courtrooms across the nation. You work with experienced attorneys to find and win cutting-edge property rights cases in trial and appellate courts, including the U.S. Supreme Court. You work as a part of a collaborative team, but are also self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision. You are eager to learn, relentless, and a focused professional.

Them: Bureaucrats, city councils, mayors, governors, and federal agencies stripping Americans of their rights every day. There’s a lot of government overreach out there against the little guys, backed by seemingly endless resources. But fortunately, abusive government is most vulnerable when countered by individuals who act strategically and nimbly, take calculated risks, have each other’s backs, and are confident in, and passionate for, the cause—the very sort of property rights swashbucklers here at PLF.

Us: We fight back. Pacific Legal Foundation is the nation’s first and most successful public interest law firm dedicated to vindicating individual liberty and protecting the fundamental right to property as the “guardian of every other right.” PLF has an unmatched record in the United States Supreme Court, with 18 victories in the Court. We also are actively litigating more than a hundred cases in trial and appellate courtrooms across the country.

We are a next-generation public interest law firm. What does “next-generation” mean for a legal nonprofit? It means we aren’t interested in doing the same thing as everyone else. We aspire to be the best player in a constantly changing game.

Here’s what you get to do in this role:

You will be a courtroom lawyer in PLF's Property Rights Practice Group, working alongside a dedicated team to find and litigate cases. We take our cases to state and federal courts at every level. From Nollan to Koontz to Knick to Wilkins, Cedar Point Nursery, and Tyler, PLF’s property rights litigation is unparalleled. You will help find and win the next important property rights case, with the goal of becoming recognized as a nationwide leader in property rights litigation. You will also occasionally have opportunities to speak at conferences or with the media about your cases or important property rights issues.

You will be a key contributor to PLF’s Property Rights practice group. You will work in teams with your fellow lawyers, growing in your expertise and knowledge and elevating the team’s efforts to defend the right to own, keep, and use private property. You will have the latitude to think big and the resources to execute. At PLF, you will be at the forefront of shaping property rights for all Americans.

In a nutshell, we’re seeking someone who’s passionate about liberty and property rights, someone who is magnanimous, and someone who is a bold and relentless freedom fighter.

Getting down to brass tacks, your specific job duties likely will include:

  • Winning property rights cases! Finding, developing, and litigating important property rights cases in all levels of courtrooms, nationwide.
  • Working with other attorneys to develop and litigate PLF’s property rights cases to protect the constitutional rights of Americans.

Qualifications:

  • 2-4 years of litigation experience or equivalent, such as judicial clerkship experience
  • Passion to litigate property rights cases
  • A deep understanding of the moral and constitutional basis for property rights is a huge plus
  • A track record of successful legal work
  • Outstanding interpersonal communications skills
  • A knowledge of, and passion for, the ideas of freedom and individual liberty
  • The ability and willingness to travel approximately 20% to 30% of your time

General Information

Pacific Legal Foundation identifies and litigates important legal issues to set landmark precedents that will benefit Americans nationwide. Using strategic and principled litigation, communications, and research, we battle for freedom in the nation’s courts and the court of public opinion.

As a national nonprofit organization, PLF has brick-and-mortar offices in Sacramento, California; Arlington, Virginia; and Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, although approximately half of the staff work from home offices across the country. You can work physically in any of our offices or request to work virtually. This position is particularly suited for a lawyer who would like to be in one of our offices, or who is a focused and relentless self-starter eager to take advantage of our cross-country virtual office environment by proactively collaborating and communicating with colleagues, clients, and other professionals.

Salary Range and Benefits:

This is a full-time, permanent position. PLF is committed to recruiting and retaining the highest-quality talent available nationwide, and we offer a total compensation package that includes a competitive salary, medical and dental insurance, and employer-paid retirement savings. We take work-life balance seriously through our generous paid leave and flextime policies. To learn more about the starting salary range and benefits options, please apply.

To Apply

Qualified candidates should submit the following application materials:

  • Your resume or C.V., including your experience in the liberty movement and relevant professional experience.
  • A cover letter explaining why PLF is the place for you, why you want to fight for liberty, and what distinguishes you from typical applicants; your letter should detail your courtroom experience, including any experience in trial preparation and civil discovery.
  • A recent legal writing sample, no longer than 10 pages, that demonstrates your analytical and advocacy skills.

Remote Clinical Trial Support Specialist
